_comment: Copy to probes.json and replace the SIGNAL queries with ones that mean something in YOUR vault. The NOISE probes are universal — keep them as they are; they are the control that proves the index measures meaning rather than structure.

probes.label: exact title
probes.query: REPLACE ME — the exact title of a note you know exists
probes.why: a one-word/title match. This is the case body-text embedding does NOT improve, so it anchors the ceiling.

probes.label: how-to question
probes.query: REPLACE ME — a real question whose answer is documented in your vault
probes.why: the everyday case: a question, not a keyword

probes.label: buried-answer question
probes.query: REPLACE ME — a question whose answer is in a note BODY, not in any title
probes.why: the case a title-only index structurally cannot reach. The clearest demonstration of why chunking matters.

probes.label: real-word nonsense
probes.why: well-formed English with no meaning in any vault. Must be rejected.

probes.label: keyboard mash
probes.why: character gibberish. On a title-only index this can out-score the relevance floor.
